image_description: Two men standing on a boat holding a very large sturgeon horizontally. The fish is the central subject, displaying a pale/white ventral side and darker dorsal side. The background shows water and distant hills under an overcast sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is somewhat elongated, but the mouth structure is indistinct and does not clearly show the characteristic ventral protrusible mouth; it appears more like a generic fish snout or is obscured by poor resolution/AI generation artifacts.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No distinct barbels are visible near the snout area. The texture in this region is smooth and lacks the specific anatomical detail of four whiskers.
The snout is visibly pointed and elongated, consistent with sturgeon morphology.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body is extremely elongated and fusiform, spanning the width of the two men holding it.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin appears smooth and rubbery rather than having distinct, sharp bony scutes. There are faint lateral lines, but they lack the 3D structural definition of sturgeon scutes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish exhibits clear countershading with a dark gray/brown back and a white belly.
The tail fin appears largely symmetrical (homocercal) or only slightly asymmetrical. It lacks the distinct upper-lobe-dominant structure of a true heterocercal tail.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin has a plastic-like, overly smooth sheen that lacks the micro-texture of real fish skin or the roughness of scutes. It looks like rendered CGI.
The hands (especially the one in red gloves on the right) merge into the fish's body without clear finger definition or proper occlusion boundaries. The grip looks physically implausible.
The fish appears unnaturally rigid and straight for its length, lacking the slight sag or natural curve expected from a heavy biological organism held at two points.
Inconsistent depth of field; the background is uniformly blurry while the foreground subjects have sharp but artificial edges.

focus_areas: Presence of bony scutes vs smooth skin
Anatomical correctness of the tail fin (heterocercal)

If the classifier says 'sturgeon' but the visual texture is smooth plastic, prioritize the visual artifact evidence. Also, scrutinize the tail shape; AI often defaults to symmetrical tails.
